'''''Carduus tenuiflorus''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Asteraceae]]. It is known variously as '''slender-flower thistle''',<ref name=grin/> '''sheep thistle''',<ref name=grin/> '''shore thistle''',<ref name=grin/> '''slender thistle''',<ref name=grin/>  '''winged plumeless thistle''',<ref>[https://plants.usda.gov/java/profile?symbol=CATE2 USDA]</ref> '''winged slender thistle'''<ref name=grin/> and '''winged thistle'''.<ref name=grin/> It is native to western Europe and Northwest Africa, and is an [[introduced species]] elsewhere.

==Description==
''Carduus tenuiflorus'' may exceed {{convert|2|m|ft}} in height. Its tall stem is ridged with wings and has long spines which may be several centimeters in length. The dull olive-green leaves are lobed and wrinkled and may fold and crease themselves.{{citation needed|date=June 2024}}

The [[inflorescence]]s may hold up to 20 [[head (botany)|flower heads]] which are somewhat rounded, covered in wide, spiny [[bract|phyllaries]], and packed with pale pink to bright purple long-tubed disc florets. This is a tenacious weed of roadsides, fields, and disturbed areas.

==Distribution==
''Carduus tenuiflorus'' is native to western [[North Africa]] in: northern [[Algeria]], [[Morocco]], and [[Tunisia]]; [[Macaronesia]]; and much of western Europe in: [[Belgium]], [[France]], including [[Corsica]], [[Ireland]], [[Italy]] including [[Sardinia]] and [[Sicily]], the [[Netherlands]], [[Portugal]], [[Spain]] including the [[Balearic Islands]], and the [[United Kingdom]].<ref name=grin/><ref>{{cite web |title=Carduus tenuiflorus Curtis |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:189106-1 |website=Plants of the World Online |access-date=26 April 2024 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Carduus tenuiflorus |url=https://www.worldplants.de/world-plants-complete-list/complete-plant-list#plantUid-363220 |website=worldplants.de |access-date=26 April 2024}}</ref>

===Introduced species===
It has become [[naturalisation (biology)|naturalised]] in [[South Africa]], [[India]], [[Australasia]], [[Southern South America]], regions of the [[United States]], and elsewhere.<ref name=grin/> It is an [[invasive species]] in [[California]].<ref>[http://www.cal-ipc.org/ip/management/plant_profiles/Carduus_tenuiflorus.php Cal-IPC (California Invasisive Plant Council): ''Carduus tenuiflorus'']. accessed 4.8.2013</ref>
